title: TMS — Territory Management System
tagline: A multi-congregation SaaS for organizing, assigning, and tracking territory work during field ministry.
overview: TMS is a standalone multi-congregation SaaS for organizing, assigning, and tracking territory work during field ministry — built with its own Supabase project, its own auth, and a fully isolated codebase from Cyberussell.com's other products.
problem: Coordinating territory assignments across a congregation by hand — paper slips, manual tracking, and no visibility into what's been covered — makes it hard for administrators and group leaders to stay organized or see progress in real time.
solution: Built a full Administrator module for managing territories, sections, blocks, and records with CSV import/export, an assignment engine with a QR-based publisher workflow that works offline and syncs later, and a Group Leader role with its own dashboard for generating assignments and reviewing stats, results, and partner activity.
results: Live and in active use, with publishers claiming and completing assignments entirely from a scanned QR code — no app install, works offline, and syncs automatically when back online.
